wargear.name: Cold-blooded Princeps
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Princeps who has spent decades listening to the reactor's heartbeat and never once let it rattle him. The Titan's controlling player may re-roll one failed Power Hungry or Overload check each battle.

wargear.name: Fire-eater Princeps
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Princeps who fights at the edge of the neural link and lets the engine run hot. Once per battle, at the start of the controlling player's Shooting Phase, the Titan may fire one weapon twice, but must then take a Power Hungry check with a -1 penalty.

wargear.name: Overlapping void arrays
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Secondary projectors are stitched into the primary lattice, so a collapsing shield is quickly replaced. The first time the Titan's void shields would be reduced to zero in a battle, restore one void shield immediately.

wargear.name: Servitor-hardened plates
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Hull plates seeded with banked servitor labour that can be called on to slap armour back over a breach. The vehicle gains +1 Hull Point.

The Reaver may take bespoke arm weapons
The Titan may take a reactor-fed arm weapon
The Titan's Princeps may have a marked temperament
The Titan may carry overlapping void arrays
The Conveyor may be armoured further

rites.name: The Hunting Pack
rites.flavor: Where the great engines march, the Warhounds have already seen the enemy's backs.
rites.text: Warhound Titans may fill Fast Attack slots, cost 50 points less and gain Vanguard (2). The pack leaves the heavy engines at the gate: no Reaver, Warbringer or Warlord Titans. At least two Warhounds are required.

require.note: A pack needs at least two Warhounds.

rites.name: The Reactor Gambit
rites.flavor: The Princeps do not ask permission of the reactor. They tell it how long it has.
rites.text: Every Titan costs 100 points less and gains Fast (1). The engines are driven past safe limits: no Titan keeps its Repair Crew, and the Legio brings no Triaros Armoured Conveyors.

rites.name: The Void-Wall Bastion
rites.flavor: A Titan is only as safe as the men who stand beneath its knees.
rites.text: Secutarii Cohorts may fill Elites slots and gain a 4+ Invulnerable Save. The Legio digs in around a single engine: no more than one Titan, and no Warbringer or Warlord.

modifiers.text: The Void-Wall Bastion: best 4+ Invulnerable Save.

rites.name: The Bonded Cybernetica Maniple
rites.flavor: The Princeps leads from the Titan's head. The Castellaxes lead from nowhere at all.
rites.text: Castellax Battle and Destructor Maniples and Domitar Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots. Castellaxes gain +1 Ballistic Skill. The Legio relies on its machines and brings no Secutarii Cohorts or Axiarchs, and only one Titan.
